_readme: Source listing for the video-based subjects. Drive subjects list folders and files; YouTube subjects list sections of either timestamped segments (long lectures, split by reading the auto-caption transcript) or whole short videos. Section titles are hand-cleaned; file/video titles are verbatim and normalised by scripts/build-subject-sheets.mjs.
